examples.text: The hare cried and complained of the terrible February cold and the disgusting chatter of the owls[.]

The wind rose as the earth darkened, so that fading chatters of woodland animals were countered by the strengthening sounds of waving trees […]

examples.text: Proper brake adjustment will help to reduce the chatter.

examples.text: The jay makes answer, as the magpie chatters with delight.
